name: EL SALVADOR

flag.title: Blue–White–Blue
flag.note: Blue stripes for the ocean; white for peace

lead: El Salvador is the smallest country in Central America. It has over 20 volcanoes, coffee forests and Pacific surf beaches. The Pipil, an Indigenous people, farmed here before the Spanish came in 1524.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: El Salvador sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire, a belt of volcanoes. Santa Ana is the highest volcano, at 2,381 m. It has a crater lake and last erupted in 2005.
The Pacific coast is 307 km long. It is the only coast, so there is no Caribbean shore. Pine highlands drop to valleys where coffee and sugar cane grow.
animals: The national bird is the turquoise-browed motmot, called the torogoz. It swings its racket-tipped tail like a pendulum.
White-tailed deer, coatis and ocelots live in the highland forests. Over 500 bird species have been recorded.
culture: Pupusas are thick cornmeal patties filled with cheese, beans or pork. People eat them with curtido, a tangy pickled cabbage.
Coffee has shaped the country since the 1880s. Festivals mix Catholic traditions with old Pipil dances and marimba (wooden xylophone) music.
history: The Pipil people, related to the Aztecs, ruled here. Spanish soldier Pedro de Alvarado arrived in 1524. Spain needed three tries to beat the Pipil warriors.
A civil war from 1979 to 1992 killed over 75,000 people. A peace deal ended it. In 2021, it became the first country to make Bitcoin (online money) official money. It reversed this in 2025.
wows: El Salvador is the only Central American country with no Caribbean coast.
A volcano buried the Maya village of Joya de Cerén in ash around AD 600, like Roman Pompeii.
Over 20 volcanoes squeeze into a space the size of Wales, a small country in Britain.
The torogoz bird swings its tail like a pendulum to show predators it has been spotted.
Indigo, a blue dye, was the top product sold abroad for 300 years, until man-made dyes ended it.
In 2021, it was the first nation to make Bitcoin (online money) official money.
Pupusa Day is a national holiday on the second Sunday of November.

myths.fact: They are seeds inside a red fruit called a coffee cherry. Each cherry usually holds two seeds.

myths.myth: El Salvador is named after a man called Salvador
myths.fact: The name is Spanish for 'The Saviour'. It honours Jesus Christ.
